title: Panel copy and flag descriptions have a length budget the tests enforce
goal: The design rules say a panel carries at most one short line of text, yet video sections carry paragraphs and experiment descriptions run to 200 words, and nothing checks. Add a length limit the test run enforces, and list every place that breaks it.
notes:
Intake detail (the goal as first filed, moved here by triage 2026-09-23): UX-PATTERNS says a panel carries at most one short line of text, yet video sections carry paragraphs, and flag descriptions run to 200 words. Nothing enforces it. Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?

Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: Scripts/test.sh fails when a panel section string exceeds the budget (60 characters, tune with the user via a card) outside an allowlist that starts empty for video
Flag descriptions capped (e.g. 40 words) with a test
A list of every existing offender app-wide, the video ones fixed by the panel task, the rest filed

log.note: triage 2026-09-23: goal rewritten in plain language, the old one kept at the top of notes

Measured by the digest pass 2026-09-23: 96 switch descriptions in FeatureCatalog.swift, median 179 words, longest 557 (Turn Into Path), 538 and 520; 92 of the 96 are over 40 words. So a 40 word cap is a rewrite of nearly the whole catalog, not a trim: the card that tunes the budget with the user should show these numbers.

video-shell.html was deleted on 2026-09-23 (task the-video-mocks-are-the-user-s-again-and-d18-is): it was the loop's own study arguing against tracks. The target is now pages/video.html, the video-*.html walkthroughs and comp-video.html, restored as the user drew them, plus UX-PATTERNS D18 (rewritten: a document with time has tracks). Where this task mentions video-shell, read video.html.

Review before building: a Premiere or Photoshop user never reads a paragraph in a properties panel; labels and values, with the why on hover. The budget has to be enforced where copy is written, and panel prose has no single component (it is Text(...) calls, helper functions and static lets across 36 files), so the gate reads source. Hover tips are exempt: UX-PATTERNS §4 sends cut sentences there.

Built: PhotonzCore/CopyBudget.swift (panelLine 60, flagDescriptionWords 40, phrases(inSwift:) reader: skips comments, joins literals glued with +, counts an interpolation as 4 chars, marks .panelHelp/.help/…Help: arguments and declarations named …Help/…Tip as tips, drops identifiers, symbol names and log calls), 13 unit tests. PanelCopyBudgetTests scans every panel file by name rule and fails a shown line over 60; FlagDescriptionBudgetTests caps descriptions at 40 words. Both carry a shrink-only allowance of the offenders of 2026-09-24; video sections (Speed, Sound, Captions, Transition, Motion, Keys, Compositing) have none. Verified the gate: a 79-char line appended to TextInspector failed everyShownLineFits.

Offender list: panel 32 lines in 11 files (Placement 12, Component 5, Columns 5, Arrangement 2, ColorStyle 2, LayerEffects 2, EffectsList 2, TextStyle 0, BlendMode 1, PanelSectionsFooter 1); flags 92 of 95 over 40 words. Fixed here (video): Motion's two-sentence line is now 'Pick one layer to add motion.' with the reason on hover; the keying paragraph moved into Tolerance/Softness/Spill hover tips and the no-backdrop note is one line; the Masked by explanations (panel and LayerMatte.explanation) cut to one line each. Filed, each blocked on a card for the budget: the-panel-s-long-lines-are-cut-to-one-short-line (40 or 60 chars) and experiments-switches-say-what-they-do-in-a-sente (25 or 40 words, or leave them).

Review after: motion-swings-a-layer-walk and layers-combine-walk green on the probe (no flags; Screen Recording granted, screen unlocked); 11-two-picked-says-why-sc.png shows 'Pick one layer to add motion.' under Motion. Left rough (not filed, under the bar): strings a panel pulls from PhotonzCore (like LayerMatte.explanation) are not scanned; tooltips have no cap of their own. Scripts/test.sh: three full runs each hit the known export-size flake (the-export-size-test-fails-about-one-run-in-thre, logged there), fourth run 9534 green.

Shipped in fe5bd41d: CopyBudget (PhotonzCore, 13 tests) reads panel source; PanelCopyBudgetTests fails any shown panel line over 60 chars and FlagDescriptionBudgetTests any switch description over 40 words, each with a shrink-only list of today's offenders (32 panel lines, 92 descriptions) and none for video sections. Video offenders fixed here (Motion one-layer line, keying paragraph to hover tips, Masked by lines). Rest filed as the-panel-s-long-lines-are-cut-to-one-short-line and experiments-switches-say-what-they-do-in-a-sente, each blocked on a budget card. Verified: gate fails on an injected 79-char line; motion-swings-a-layer and layers-combine walks green with no flags; Scripts/test.sh 9534 green (earlier runs hit the known export-size flake).
